schema_note: sprint_id 'V2' intentionally deviates from the ^S\d+$ regex in schema.schema.json, which was scoped to V1 sprints only. Acknowledged in lld.json schema_note. The meta-schema pattern will be relaxed to ^(S\d+|V\d+)$ at the next schema meta-update.

schema_amendments.description: V2 introduces 5 new tables via migration 0004_v2_auth_pricing_tables. M-008 adds tbl_user_master for authentication and RBAC. M-011 adds tbl_price_master, tbl_invoice_header, tbl_invoice_line, and tbl_payment for the Pricing & Invoicing module. M-009 (Inward Report) and M-010 (Report Export) are fully read-only over existing S1/S2 tables — zero new tables or columns for those modules.

entities.name: tbl_user_master

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK autoincrement.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Login identifier. UNIQUE NOT NULL. Case-sensitive match in UserRepository.get_by_username. Max 100 chars per UserCreate schema validation.

fields.name: password_hash
fields.description: bcrypt hash via passlib CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt']) per DS-018. Never stored as plain text. 255 chars accommodates bcrypt $2b$ prefix + 60-char hash.

fields.name: role
fields.description: RBAC role per DS-019. CHECK(role IN ('STAFF','VERIFIER','SUPERVISOR')). Snapshotted into JWT payload at login; get_current_user re-reads from DB on each request so a role change takes effect immediately (within the same 8h TTL window).

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag per DS-008. Inactive users cannot log in and are rejected by get_current_user on every request regardless of a still-valid token. Bounds exposure window per DS-018.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-side default via TimestampMixin per DS-014. Audit trail for SUPERVISOR user-management operations.

indexes: ix_user_master_username ON tbl_user_master(username) — supports UserRepository.get_by_username O(1) lookup. Called on every login attempt AND on every authenticated API request via get_current_user (which fetches by JWT sub claim = username).
used_by_v2_files: backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/auth.py — ORM model definition
backend/src/infrastructure/db/repositories/auth.py — UserRepository (get_by_username, list_active)
backend/src/application/services/auth_service.py — authenticate, create_user, list_users, update_user
backend/scripts/seed_default_user.py — inserts default admin SUPERVISOR row (idempotent)
design_notes: DS-018: role VARCHAR CHECK instead of Postgres ENUM type per DS-019 — avoids ALTER TYPE migration if a 4th role is added in V3.
DS-018: no refresh tokens in V2; 8h TTL + is_active re-check on every request is the deactivation mechanism. Deactivated user's token becomes effectively revoked within one request cycle.
DS-019: three fixed roles (STAFF, VERIFIER, SUPERVISOR) map directly to PRD user types. No separate roles table — enum column is O(1) read from JWT payload on each request.

entities.name: tbl_price_master

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK autoincrement.

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: FK tbl_trading_design_master.id. Part of the unique price key (design, grade, effective_from). ORM relationship PriceMasterModel.design with lazy='joined' for design_name + size resolution in PriceMasterRead.

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: FK tbl_grade_master.id. Part of the unique price key. ORM relationship PriceMasterModel.grade with lazy='joined' for grade_code resolution in PriceMasterRead.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per NOS unit. CHECK(unit_price >= 0) — zero is valid (placeholder). Snapshotted onto tbl_invoice_line.unit_price at invoice creation per DS-022; future edits to this row never retroact on existing invoices.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: Date from which this price becomes valid. Active price lookup (DS-022): WHERE is_active=true AND effective_from <= invoice_date ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1 — the most recent effective price on or before the invoice date.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Soft-delete flag per DS-008. SUPERVISOR can retire a price row via PATCH /prices/{id} without deleting it. Retired rows remain visible in GET /prices (admin history view).

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Audit trail.

indexes: uq_price_design_grade_effective UNIQUE ON tbl_price_master(design_id, grade_id, effective_from) — (1) enforces the business rule that no two prices exist for the same (design, grade, date); (2) the (design_id, grade_id) prefix services PriceMasterRepository.get_active_price equality filter, with effective_from range scan for ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1.
used_by_v2_files: backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/pricing.py — ORM model: PriceMasterModel
backend/src/infrastructure/db/repositories/pricing.py — PriceMasterRepository (get_active_price, list_all)
backend/src/application/services/pricing_service.py — list_prices, create_price, update_price
backend/src/application/services/invoice_service.py — get_active_price called per sales line at invoice creation
design_notes: DS-022: effective-from price lookup gives time-aware pricing — a price change on 2026-08-01 does not affect invoices generated before that date.
DS-022: unit_price snapshot on tbl_invoice_line (not a FK to this row) ensures immutable historical invoice totals even if this row is later edited.
DS-023: if no active price exists for a (design, grade) pair, InvoiceService uses unit_price=0 with a warning note on the invoice line — invoice creation does not block.
DS-008: soft-delete preserves price history for audit. list_all() returns all rows including inactive so SUPERVISOR can see the full price timeline.

entities.name: tbl_invoice_header

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK autoincrement.

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Human-readable invoice ID. Generated deterministically by domain.invoice.generate_invoice_number as 'INV-{YYYYMMDD}-{sales_header_id:05d}'. UNIQUE — deterministic generation means a duplicate creation attempt (same sales_header_id) produces the same invoice_number and collides on this constraint, returning a clean 409 per DS-023.

fields.name: sales_header_id
fields.description: FK tbl_sales_header.id. UNIQUE — enforces exactly one invoice per sale (DS-023). InvoiceService.create_from_sales checks this via a SELECT before insert to return a clean 409 rather than catching IntegrityError.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Date the invoice was generated (today() at creation time per InvoiceService.create_from_sales). Used in InvoiceRepository.list date_from/date_to filter.

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Sum of all invoice_line.line_total values. Computed by domain.invoice.compute_invoice_total and persisted — enables fast status recomputation in record_payment without re-summing lines from DB.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status. CHECK(status IN ('PENDING','PARTIAL','PAID')). Recomputed in application layer by compute_invoice_status after each payment recorded; synchronously updated in the same DB transaction.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Audit trail.

indexes: UNIQUE (invoice_number) — implicit B-tree; enforces invoice_number uniqueness and supports fast lookup if needed.
UNIQUE (sales_header_id) — implicit B-tree; enforces one-invoice-per-sale (DS-023) and supports InvoiceService.create_from_sales existence check.
ix_invoice_header_invoice_date ON tbl_invoice_header(invoice_date) — services InvoiceRepository.list date_from/date_to filter.
used_by_v2_files: backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/pricing.py — ORM model: InvoiceHeaderModel
backend/src/infrastructure/db/repositories/pricing.py — InvoiceRepository (create_with_lines, get, list)
backend/src/application/services/invoice_service.py — create_from_sales, list_invoices, get_invoice, record_payment
design_notes: DS-023: UNIQUE(sales_header_id) is the authoritative guard against double-invoicing — the service pre-checks but the DB constraint is the final safety net.
status is recomputed in memory by compute_invoice_status (domain layer) and written back synchronously — no DB trigger needed.
total_amount is computed and stored at creation time; it is immutable after creation since invoice lines are also immutable. Only status changes via payment recording.

entities.name: tbl_invoice_line

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK autoincrement.

fields.name: invoice_header_id
fields.description: FK tbl_invoice_header.id. Groups lines under one invoice. Used in ix_invoice_line_header for eager loading.

fields.name: sales_line_id
fields.description: FK tbl_sales_line.id. UNIQUE — one invoice line per sales line; prevents the same unit of sale from appearing on two invoices.

fields.name: design_id
fields.description: Denormalized snapshot of sales_line.design_id at invoice creation time. Immutable. Same snapshot pattern as DS-013 (place) and DS-022 (unit_price). Enables InvoiceLineRead to display design_id without re-joining to tbl_sales_line.

fields.name: grade_id
fields.description: Denormalized snapshot of sales_line.grade_id at invoice creation time. Immutable. Design/grade names resolved via lazy='joined' relationships on PriceMasterModel (not re-derived from this column at runtime — InvoiceLineRead joins to master tables for names).

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Snapshot of tbl_sales_line.nos at invoice creation time. Immutable. Changing a sales line's NOS after invoicing does not alter the invoice quantity.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Point-in-time price snapshot per DS-022. Copied from the active tbl_price_master row at invoice creation. Future price master edits never retroact. Zero if no active price configured (DS-023 zero-price fallback).

fields.name: line_total
fields.description: quantity × unit_price computed by domain.invoice.compute_line_total (ROUND_HALF_UP, 2dp) and stored at creation. Immutable.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Audit trail.

indexes: UNIQUE (sales_line_id) — implicit B-tree; prevents same sales_line from appearing on two invoices.
ix_invoice_line_header ON tbl_invoice_line(invoice_header_id) — services InvoiceRepository.get joinedload of lines and InvoiceRepository.create_with_lines flush.
used_by_v2_files: backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/pricing.py — ORM model: InvoiceLineModel
backend/src/infrastructure/db/repositories/pricing.py — InvoiceRepository.create_with_lines (inserts header + N lines in a single SQLAlchemy flush)
backend/src/application/services/invoice_service.py — builds lines_data from sales_line rows + active price lookups
design_notes: DS-022: unit_price is a point-in-time snapshot — identical immutability pattern to tbl_inward_header.place (DS-013). Post-creation price edits never silently change historical invoice totals.
design_id and grade_id are snapshotted (not FK references) so InvoiceLineRead can display values even if the original design or grade is later soft-deleted.
UNIQUE(sales_line_id) is the authoritative guard against duplicate invoice lines — a sales_line can appear on exactly one invoice across the system lifetime.

entities.name: tbl_payment

fields.name: id
fields.description: PK autoincrement.

fields.name: invoice_header_id
fields.description: FK tbl_invoice_header.id. Payments are append-only — no UPDATE or DELETE on this table.

fields.name: payment_date
fields.description: Date of payment as entered by SUPERVISOR. No date-range restriction beyond basic non-null.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount. CHECK(amount > 0) — zero and negative amounts are rejected at DB level. InvoiceService.record_payment additionally validates that cumulative payments do not exceed invoice total_amount (422 overpayment guard in application layer).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. cheque number, bank reference). Not required for payment recording.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Audit trail. Append-only semantics mean this is also the definitive record of when the payment was entered.

indexes: ix_payment_invoice_header ON tbl_payment(invoice_header_id) — services InvoiceRepository.get joinedload of all payments for an invoice, and the payment sum aggregation in InvoiceService.record_payment for compute_invoice_status.
used_by_v2_files: backend/src/infrastructure/db/models/pricing.py — ORM model: PaymentModel
backend/src/infrastructure/db/repositories/pricing.py — PaymentRepository.create
backend/src/application/services/invoice_service.py — record_payment: appends payment row then recomputes and updates invoice status
design_notes: Payments are insert-only. Corrections are handled by SUPERVISOR adding a corrective payment entry — the append-only table preserves a complete payment audit trail.
Overpayment guard is in InvoiceService.record_payment (application layer) because the DB CHECK cannot know the running total without a trigger. DB CHECK only enforces amount > 0.

operations_in_order: CREATE TABLE tbl_user_master (id, username, password_hash, role, is_active, created_at)
CREATE TABLE tbl_price_master (id, design_id, grade_id, unit_price, effective_from, is_active, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE CONSTRAINT uq_price_design_grade_effective ON tbl_price_master(design_id, grade_id, effective_from)
CREATE TABLE tbl_invoice_header (id, invoice_number, sales_header_id, invoice_date, total_amount, status, created_at)
CREATE TABLE tbl_invoice_line (id, invoice_header_id, sales_line_id, design_id, grade_id, quantity, unit_price, line_total, created_at)
CREATE TABLE tbl_payment (id, invoice_header_id, payment_date, amount, notes, created_at)
migration_plan.post_migration_script: backend/scripts/seed_default_user.py — inserts default admin SUPERVISOR user (username=admin, password=admin123). Idempotent — no-ops if admin already exists. Run once after alembic upgrade head on a fresh or migrated database. Print warning to change password on first login.
migration_plan.rationale: Creation order respects FK constraints: tbl_user_master is standalone (no FK to existing tables). tbl_price_master depends on tbl_trading_design_master + tbl_grade_master (S1 — already in place). tbl_invoice_header depends on tbl_sales_header (S2 — already in place). tbl_invoice_line depends on tbl_invoice_header (created immediately before it) + tbl_sales_line (S2). tbl_payment depends on tbl_invoice_header. Downgrade order is strict reverse FK order.
